Title: 2D Environment setting: Move with Arrow Keys
Content: Objective Select and move Patterns, Internal Shapes, points and lines by set increments using arrow keys on the keyboard. Location Move Patterns with Arrow Keys Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern Set Increments for Arrow Keys Main Menu Preferences 2D Pattern Window Properties (F12) Property Editor Arrow Key Movement Right Click Pop-Up Menu (On 2D Window) 2D Pattern Window Properties (F12) Property Editor Arrow Key Movement Operation Move Patterns with Arrow Keys 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern Select Patterns, Internal Shapes, points, and lines to be moved and hit respective arrow keys to move the selected item. Set Increments for Arrow Keys Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Preferences 2D Pattern Window Properties (F12) Property Editor Arrow Key Movement Right Click Pop-Up Menu (On 2D Window) 2D Pattern Window Properties (F12) Property Editor Arrow Key Movement 2. Enter the desired value for Arrow Key Movement.

Title: Custom View
Content: Objective Easily open and save custom view of the 3D window at your convenience. Location Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View Operation Create Rotate the 3D Window as desired. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Left click on the camera icon on the right top corner. The current view is saved and added to the Custom View window. Double click on the added custom view. The 3D Window rotates automatically to reflect the custom view. Open/Save Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Add the desired custom view. Click on the Open or the Save All button. The group of custom views is opened or saved. Delete Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Add the desired custom view. Right-click on the custom view to be deleted. The right-click pop-up menu appears. Select Delete. The selected custom view is deleted from the Custom View window. Rename Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Viewpoint Custom View Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) Custom View The Custom View window appears. Add the desired custom view. Right click on the custom view to be deleted. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Rename. Edit the name as the custom view's name field is activated. Note: Starting from ver4.1.0, Delete All or Overwrite custom views using the right-click pop-up menu.

Title: CLOSET (Below ver4.2.0)
Content: Objective Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. Shortcut keys, menus, graphic options, view controls, default files, font settings and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. In CLOSET section, configure login settings necessary to use CLOSET related features (File Share and CLOSET Render). Location Main Menu Setting User Setting CLOSET Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Setting User Setting CLOSET Login Choose the login information to be used. OnlineAuth: Use the software login credentials. CLOSET: Use the CLOSET login credentials. When this option is on, please type in corresponding ID and PW.

Title: Others (Below ver4.2.0)
Content: Objective Change the default settings of the software in User Settings. Designated settings will become the default after the program is restarted. Shortcut keys, menus, graphics options, view controls, default files, font settings, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. Location Main Menu Settings User Settings Others Operation Adjust the settings below as needed: Main Menu Settings User Settings Others Toolbar 3D Toolbar Organize the 3D toolbar in the top, bottom, right, or left side of the window (ver4.0.0). 2D Toolbar Organize the 2D toolbar in the top, bottom, right, or left side of the window (ver4.0.0). Show Manual and Video Links from Tooltips Toggle on or off the check box next to the option to show or hide tooltips with manual and tutorial links (ver4.1.0). Arrangement Default Arrangement Shape Type Arrange the pattern as curved or flat around the bounding volume of the Avatar when placing patterns around the avatar with arrangement points. Default Arrangement Point Size Modify the default arrangement point size (radius). For smaller avatars, the default arrangement point size may hinder pattern arrangement, so decrease the size of the arrangement points for efficient pattern arrangement. Pattern Default Particle Distance Set the default particle distance when creating patterns. Automatically Offset 2D Patterns when Cut Toggle the option to offset 2D patterns when the Cut function is used, making it easier to work with UV export (ver3.2.0). Mesh Set the default mesh setting to Triangle or Quad. Unit Set the measurement unit (inch, centimeter, millimeter) for the program. The software must be restarted for the changes to apply. Auto Save Change the frequency (minutes) the program automatically saves the Garment file in the background (ver2.4.0). Gizmo Unified Gizmo: Select, move, and rotate with a single Gizmo tool. Divided Gizmo: Select (Q), Move (W), Rotate (E) are divided into separate Gizmo tools. The Divided Gizmo tool automatically reassigns the Pin shortcut key from W to P on the keyboard. If P is already in use as a shortcut key, a shortcut key will not be applied to Pin (ver2.5.0). Multiview Copy images created with Multiview to the clipboard.

Title: Set Graphic Options (Below ver4.2.0)
Content: Objective Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. Shortcut keys, menus, graphic options, view controls, default files, font settings and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. Location Main Menu Settings User Settings Graphic Options Operation Navigate to the menu as below: Main Menu Settings User Settings Graphic Options Adjust the settings as needed: Show Shadow Shows or hides Avatar shadows by default. Use Shader Sets whether or not the shader is used. The shader makes the shade of objects appear smoother. Use Normal Map Set the Normal Map usage to realistically express the 3D Seamlines and tecture of the fabric. ANTIALISING Sets how smooth the outlines of objects appear. As the number increases, the outlines become smoother and the rendering speed becomes slower. Use VBOs Set the VBOs usage in order to improve the rendering speed.

Title: Updating Network Software License
Content: To update existing Software License Key due to renewing license or adding copies, please follow the instruction below. 1. Generate C2V file with the RUS executable file, located at the bottom of this post, and submit your C2V file through this page (Logging in with your Company ID is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com 2. The Marvelous Designer Team will send back a V2C file for your license update. 3. Update the received V2C file by directing the RUS to the folder location of your V2C file at the bottom of the "Apply License File" tab and then clicking "Apply Update". Double checking an updated License Key If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1. Open a web browser and access to http://localhost:1947 2. Make sure all the information is in this part. 3. Click Features once you see the key info. 4. Make sure the number in the red box has been changed correctly.

Title: Rehost Software License Key to another environment
Content: In order to move your software license key from one environment to another, please follow the steps below. * Please note that this rehost feature is only available if your software license key was generated as a rehostable type. ** If your Software License Key name includes Rehostable on the ACC page, youre eligible to move a software license key to another environment. (ACC Page) Step 1. Collect and Save Information - on a recipient device or PC 1. Open RUS on the destination machine that you want to transfer the SL license to (RUS is attached at the bottom) 2. Click the Transfer License tab on the top menu and click the box next to Save recipient information to. Then name the file according to your preference. 3. Click Collect and Save Information, then the .id file will be saved on the destination machine. Step 2. Generate License Transfer File - on the original device or PC where the software license key is currently installed 1. Copy the .id file that was created from step 1 to the original machine which currently has the SL License installed. 2. Open RUS and click the Transfer License tab. 3. Find the software license key that you want to transfer under the Key Type section and click. 4. Load the .id file to Read the recipient information file 5. Click Generate the license transfer file then name the file according to your preference. 6. Click Generate License Transfer File to create a .h2h file. Step 3. After generating the file, the license will disappear from the source machine. As a result, the software license key is no longer installed on the original environment. Step 4. Apply Update 1. Once the .h2h file is created, copy the .h2h file to the destination machine. 2. Open RUS again and click Apply License File to load the file. 3. Click Apply Update Step 5. You can now check the transferred License on your destination machine on the ACC page (Link to ACC Page)

Title: Requesting Network Offline License Activation For A Separate License - Second or Above Installation (Window OS)
Content: Step 1. Open ACC Page to make sure your server has the HASP Driver installed. If the following screen appears, then the installation is still functioning. If not, install the HASP Driver by following the steps below. a. Download the driver from the link here (HASP Driver Download Link). b. Press 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' and then enter "CMD" in the text field to open the Command Prompt window. (Example) c. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and drop it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path, as shown underlined in the image below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on the keyboard to install. (Example) d. In a web browser, navigate to http://localhost:1947 and check to see if the following screen appears to verify the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. * If an error message pops up, please refer to the troubleshooting manual for Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows part. (Link to the Manual) Step 2. Now you're ready to create a new C2V file. Please download the Multi C2V Generator program and open it. (C2V generator download) Step 3. Click the folder icon, then you can set up the file name and designate the file path in the window that appears. Step 4. Set up the file name with your preference, and click the Save button. Step 5. Click the Generate button in order to generate the file. Step 6. Check the file at designated location to make sure it has been created successfully. Submit your C2V file to this page (Login with company account is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com You will then receive a V2C file from our team to complete the application of the license to your server. Applying a V2C on the server In order to complete a license update with a V2C file, please follow the steps below. 1. Download the V2C file sent to you from the Marvelous Designer Support Team. 2. Click on the link below to access the ACC Page, then select Update/Attach in the Options section on the left. (Click here to link ACC Page) 3. Click Choose File to find and select the downloaded V2C file. 4. Click Apply File. 5. If the update is successful, the following message will be printed. Double checking an updated License Key If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1. Open a web browser and navigate to the ACC Page 2. Click Features once you see the key info. 3. Make sure the number in the red box has been changed to the correct number of licenses.

Title: Requesting Network Software License activation - First Time installation (Linux OS)
Content: Software License Key for Network Offline Generate a C2V for First Time Installation - Linux OS 1. Install a Run-time Environment on your Linux server following by steps below (step1, step2) Step 1. Unzip aksusbd-8.31.1.tar (aksusbd-8.31.1 Download) Step 2. As root, open a terminal window and enter the command: ./dinst Once you are completed with steps above(step1, step2), youre ready to generate a C2V file for the first time installation of an SL key. Step 3. Open a web browser and navigate to (ACC Page) Step 4. Click on the Fingerprint button to create a C2V file. Step 5. Submit your C2V file to this page (Login with company account is required). If you experience any difficulties, please contact us via support@marvelousdesigner.com Step 6. Please refer below to complete a V2C key update. Applying a V2C on the server 1. Download the V2C file sent to you from Marvelous Designer Support Team. 2. Click on the link below to access the ACC Page, then select Update/Attach in Options on the left. (Click here to link ACC Page) 3. Click Choose File to find and select the downloaded V2C file. 4. Click Apply File. 5. If the update is successful, the following message will be printed. Double checking an updated License Key If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1. Open a web browser and navigate to ACC Page 2. Click Features once you see the key info. 3. Make sure the number in the red box has been changed to the correct number.

Title: My character skinned in 3dsmax looks a bit different after exporting as an open-collada format.
Content: Skinning an avatar in 3dsmax includes two categories called "Skin" and "Physics". An Open-Collada file format can only support the "Skin" way perfectly. If you face an issue importing an Open Collada file or importing an avatar including animation, please try with FBX either Alembic file format with PC2.
